name: Journey to Stonetalon Peak
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The forest spirits tell me you are brave and willing to travel.

To the south, not far from Mystral Lake, there lies a tunnel named The Talondeep Path. Through this tunnel you will come to an area known as Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. Once there, journey to the southwest past Cragpool Lake and then north, up the steep slope until you reach Stonetalon Peak.

There awaits Keeper Albagorm. Heed his bidding, friend.

The journey will be perilous.
narrative.objectives: Travel to Keeper Albagorm on Stonetalon Peak.
narrative.offerRewardText: Alas, you arrive. I see Faldreas has listened to the forest spirits...
